title: The Tai Languages of Assam: A Grammar and Texts (Khamyang Monograph)
title_as: অসমৰ টাই ভাষাসমূহ: ব্যাকৰণ আৰু পাঠ সংকলন (ড° ষ্টিফেন ম'ৰী, ২০০৫)
author: Dr. Stephen Morey, Ph.D. (La Trobe University / ANU)
provenance: Pacific Linguistics 565, Research School of Pacific and Asian Studies, The Australian National University
description: Foundational grammatical and textual monograph on the Tai languages of Assam (Khamyang, Aiton, Phake, Khamti, and Ahom). Contains extensive acoustic tonal analysis of the Khamyang 6-tone system, discourse syntax, classifier typology, and interlinear folklore transcribed from elders Chaw Sa Myat Chowlik and Deben Chowlik.
